claim:recover-mass-action.proposition: Recovered faithfully from data: SINDy discovers the 3-reaction network and the fit reproduces the trajectories (nrmse ~1e-9). The cycle rebuilds this flat mass-action SBML from data alone.
claim:recover-mass-action.hypothesis:
Mass-action is the floor: linear/bilinear rate laws and a handful of reactions.
The cycle should recover both the trajectory (to tight tolerance) and the exact
reaction set + rate constants with no spurious reactions, calibrating the
trajectory and structural scoring for the whole ladder.

claim:recover-enzyme-kinetics.proposition: Not yet recovered: the conserved moiety (E+ES const) makes the from-data regression ill-conditioned (nrmse 0.11 > 0.05 tol, 31 spurious reactions). The system IS flat mass-action -- a METHOD gap (needs moiety-aware regression). See follow-up recover-enzyme-moiety-aware.
claim:recover-enzyme-kinetics.hypothesis:
Both the elementary mechanism and the reduced saturating law fit the observed
product/substrate trajectories. The cycle recovers the trajectory out of the box,
but choosing the right structural form requires a rate-law-fitter and a parsimony
evaluator: with only substrate/product observed, the reduced MM law is the
parsimonious recovery; the elementary steps are only warranted if ES is observed.

claim:recover-gene-switch.proposition: REFUTED as flat-MASS-ACTION-recoverable: the switch's Hill kinetics a/(1+v^3) are non-polynomial, so no mass-action network fits (nrmse 0.58, 0 reactions recovered). Recoverability is rate-law-class-relative -- a faithful flat SBML needs rational rate laws. See follow-up recover-gene-switch-rational-laws.
claim:recover-gene-switch.hypothesis:
Genuine nonlinearity and bistability mean a one-shot fit is insufficient: the
cycle's frontier (what the current candidate fails to explain — e.g. the second
stable branch or the switch sharpness) must drive the search. The loop recovers
the Hill term (coefficient and threshold) and reproduces bistability only once
reaction-proposal + rate-law-fitting capabilities handle the nonlinear regulation.

claim:recover-oscillator.proposition: Not recovered from a single trajectory: the Brusselator limit-cycle structure is under-determined (nrmse 0.44; recovered model does not oscillate). The system IS flat mass-action -- a DATA-RICHNESS/method gap (ensemble trajectories, weak-form SINDy). See follow-up recover-oscillator-data-richness.
claim:recover-oscillator.hypothesis:
Dynamic structure is the hardest recovery: a model can track one trajectory
window yet fail to sustain the limit cycle. The cycle recovers the oscillation
only when it recovers the feedback topology (the repression/autocatalytic loop),
which demands frontier-driven proposal of the right reactions plus parameter
fitting that preserves the Hopf regime — the rung most likely to expose capability
gaps and, if unrecoverable as flat SBML, to trigger the non-recoverability check.

claim:recover-stochastic-abm.proposition: Reject a stochastic system (no flat-SBML form)
claim:recover-stochastic-abm.hypothesis:
A single Gillespie trajectory at low copy numbers has noisy derivatives that no
smooth polynomial (mass-action) RHS can fit, so the non-recoverability detector
flags it (worst-species R^2 well below threshold). The underlying network IS flat
SBML only in the large-population mean-field limit; from this data it is not
recoverable. The adversarial passes by correctly REJECTING the system — the honest
failure that keeps the loop from overfitting noise.

claim:recover-enzyme-moiety-aware.proposition: Moiety-aware recovery of the enzyme network
claim:recover-enzyme-moiety-aware.hypothesis: Removing the conserved-moiety rank deficiency lets the sparse fit isolate the true three reactions (S+E->ES, ES->S+E, ES->E+P) within the 0.05 trajectory tolerance. The system is flat mass-action, so this is a method gap.

claim:recover-oscillator-data-richness.proposition: Data richness for limit-cycle structure discovery
claim:recover-oscillator-data-richness.hypothesis: Multiple excitations plus weak-form derivatives break the monomial correlation and recover the source/sink + autocatalytic (2X+Y->3X) structure within tol. A data-richness + method gap, not a refutation of recoverability.

claim:recover-gene-switch-rational-laws.proposition: Recovery beyond mass-action: rational/Hill rate laws
claim:recover-gene-switch-rational-laws.hypothesis: Extending the proposer to rational rate laws recovers the switch where mass-action provably cannot. Open question for the expert: the admissible rate-law class for 'faithful flat SBML'.

claim:recoverability-frontier.proposition: Recoverability is rate-law-class-, data-richness-, and determinism-relative -- not a single pass/fail. Mass-action recovers; Michaelis-Menten needs moiety-aware fitting; the oscillator needs richer data; the Hill switch is unrecoverable as mass-action (needs rational laws); the stochastic system has no flat form at all. The frontier -- not a 5/5 pass -- is the finding.
claim:recoverability-frontier.hypothesis: Recoverability is not binary -- it is relative to (i) the RATE-LAW CLASS (mass-action recovers; Hill does not, without rational laws), (ii) DATA RICHNESS (one limit-cycle trajectory under-determines structure), and (iii) DETERMINISM (stochastic/low-copy systems have no flat form at all). The cycle's value is mapping this frontier.

narrative.question:
Run as a closed build -> simulate -> compare -> refine loop, can the
discovery-engine cycle recover faithful FLAT SBML models from synthetic
time-series targets across a ladder of biological scenarios (mass-action ->
enzyme kinetics -> gene switch -> oscillator), and what modular, vivarium-style
capabilities must be built to close the gaps where it can't?
